_note: Authored from a -DumpUia tree of the main window. Almost nothing in this app carries an AutomationId, so routes invoke by visible NAME — which means a copy change to a button silently breaks a route. Find-UiaElement matches Name OR AutomationId, so add ids and switch these over if routes start missing. Surfaces reachable only through a nested picker (library) or a non-Invoke control (tray menu, streamer toggle) are captured in -Watch mode instead; they are listed in the checklist, not here.
